key_points: Q3 2026 earnings beat estimates with revenue up ~5.6% to $25.3B.
Company lowered full-year earnings guidance, citing slower-than-expected North America turnaround.
Jefferies maintained Hold rating with $152 price target; Barron's noted turnaround lacks fizz.
PEP now trades at lowest P/E in five years, reflecting valuation pressure.
Mixed reaction: beat supports stock, but guidance cut drives near-term bearish bias.
